@graph.name: Cascade vocabulary and standard queries
@graph.description: The ontology and shapes files a Cascade Bridge Adapter's output is read against: clinical terms copied from the-cascade-protocol/spec under their own IRIs, each naming the commit it was copied from with dct:source, and the records and judgments terms first declared here. Beside them, the standard SPARQL queries over a pod written in those terms; each derivation and each lens carries the position it runs at. Under runtime/, the rules a runtime follows when it fills a pod, as Gherkin feature files with the examples that show each rule, the steps they are written in, and the scripted input the examples name. Under conformance/, the scenarios every runtime must pass: Alex Rivera's story and Priya Natarajan's, each with its scripted input and its right answers.
